description: This source file implements the 'git bugreport' command, providing functionality to generate a comprehensive bug report including system info, hooks, diagnostics, and a report template. It handles command-line options, creates report files, and gathers environment and repository diagnostics.

methods.name: void get_system_info(struct strbuf * sys_info)
methods.description: Collects system environment details such as git version, uname info, compiler info, libc info, and current shell environment, appending them to the provided string buffer.

methods.name: void get_populated_hooks(struct strbuf * hook_info,int nongit)
methods.description: Retrieves the list of hooks configured in the repository, adding their names to the provided string buffer unless the repository is not a git repository.

methods.name: int get_bug_template(struct strbuf * template)
methods.description: Populates the provided string buffer with a predefined template text for bug reporting.

methods.name: void get_header(struct strbuf * buf,const char * title)
methods.description: Adds a header with a given title to the string buffer.

methods.name: int cmd_bugreport(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main function that handles the 'git bugreport' command: processes command-line options, generates the report file with system info, hooks, and diagnostics, and invokes an editor for the report.
